title: Spaces
notes: Selecting by number, the Ctrl+G S space picker, an unnamed space named after its git checkout and found by its branch, renaming and closing.

steps.name: api's shell goes into a checkout's subfolder
steps.note: api is unnamed: it keeps its checkout's name (api), not the subfolder's (app).

send.text: git init -q && git -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.invalid commit -q --allow-empty -m e2e && git checkout -q -b e2e-branch && mkdir -p crates/app && cd crates/app && pwd

steps.name: show api
steps.note: Its shell printed the subfolder it is in.

steps.name: ask before closing a space
steps.note: ctrl-g x opens the confirm dialog; a script's space.close never asks.

herdr-app.skip: space.close from a script fails instead of asking
